result.summary: The layout is mostly coherent, but several visual inconsistencies stand out: the bottom navigation highlights 'Profile' while the Home feed is displayed, the horizontal carousel items are hard-clipped without any visual affordance, favorite (heart) buttons use two different styles, and one restaurant thumbnail has a light background while all others are dark.

issues.description: The bottom tab bar highlights 'Profile' (green icon + label) even though the screen shown is the Home/discovery feed. The active tab does not match the visible content.
issues.suggestion: Bind the active tab state to the current route so 'Home' is highlighted on this screen.

issues.description: The third card in 'Fastest near you' ('Trattoria Piccol…') is hard-cut by the viewport edge with the title truncated mid-word and no ellipsis or peek affordance; the category chip row is similarly sliced mid-chip.
issues.suggestion: Add consistent horizontal padding/peek to the carousel, apply text-overflow: ellipsis to card titles, and add a fade or arrow affordance to indicate scrollability.

issues.description: The two favorite buttons use inconsistent styling: the Tokumaru Ramen card has a white circle with a dark outlined heart, while the pizza card has a dark circle with a white heart.
issues.suggestion: Standardize the favorite button on one style (e.g. semi-transparent dark circle with white heart) for all cards regardless of image brightness.

issues.description: The 'Green Bowl Poké' thumbnail has a near-white/light background while the sibling cards use dark photographic backgrounds, making the row look unfinished and reducing contrast for the white '15–25 min' badge.
issues.suggestion: Normalize thumbnail treatment (consistent image crop/overlay gradient) and ensure badges keep contrast on light images.

issues.description: The bottom pizza card is cut off by the bottom navigation bar with no visible name, rating or bottom spacing, so the list appears to end abruptly behind the nav.
issues.suggestion: Add bottom padding equal to the nav bar height (plus safe-area inset) to the scroll container.

issues.description: The '€0 delivery' and '−20%' promo badges and the notification bell's red dot convey information by color/graphic only, and the heart buttons have no visible text label.
issues.suggestion: Provide accessible labels (e.g. 'Add to favourites', 'Free delivery', '20% off', 'Unread notifications') and ensure badge text meets 4.5:1 contrast.
